items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Uh, uh, uh, uh, Kimble. Oh, Kimble? Kimble played left hand guitar. Is that right? Yeah. I didn't know. [INTERVIEWEE] I know a fella not who's playing left hand.

ctx.x: Yeah. He played the guitar around, yeah. Did you ever know any left hand guitar players? Yeah.
